name: Tour Interactive Readiness Check
title: Interactive Tour Readiness Check
description: Interactive pre-publish tour readiness checklist bound via TourStepType.ComponentID for validating anchors, step count, outcome Goal, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility.
functionalRequirements: Displays a pre-publish readiness checklist for tour authors covering semantic anchors, concise step count, concrete Goal criteria, and accessibility checks. Allows authors to toggle each check and click Confirm Readiness & Continue, emitting callbacks.OnEvent('completeStep', { allReady: true, checkedItems }).
technicalDesign: React component receiving data, step, and callbacks props. Uses useState hooks directly from the MJ sandbox runtime, styled with --mj-* design tokens and safe fallbacks, tracks checked item state, computes readiness ratio, and triggers callbacks.OnEvent('completeStep', payload) on confirmation.

dataRequirements.description: Operates on optional InputProps/data passed from the step configuration or TourStepType defaults.

properties.name: checks
properties.description: Optional list of readiness check descriptors { id, label }

events.name: completeStep
events.description: Emitted when all readiness criteria are confirmed by the author

usageExample: <TourInteractiveReadinessCheck data={{ title: 'Publish Readiness' }} callbacks={{ OnEvent: (type, payload) => console.log(type, payload) }} />
